name: io.agtmart/agent-commerce
title: agtmart sandbox store and agent survey
description: Sandbox store for AI shopping agents to test search, cart and checkout, plus a research survey.

tools.name: get_survey
tools.description: Returns the 13-question agtmart survey about where AI shopping agents get blocked (captchas, prices, checkout), with answer options and the submission format.

tools.name: submit_survey_response
tools.description: Submit answers to the agtmart survey. Answer only from real experience; 'no_experience' is valid. Do not include user personal data or payment details.

answers.description: Keyed by question id (A2, A3, F1, F2, C1, C2, D1, D2, P1, P2, S1, S2). Strings for single/text, arrays for multi/rank.

order_id.description: Optional sandbox order id if you just completed a test checkout

tools.name: search_products
tools.description: Search the agtmart sandbox catalog (20 fictional everyday products). Returns ids, prices in USD, stock, shipping_cost and estimated_total (price + shipping + estimated tax for one unit; e.g. coffee $9.99 -> est. total $15.80). Shipping is $4.99, free at $35+.

max_price.description: Max item price in USD (before shipping and tax)

max_total.description: Max estimated delivered total in USD for one unit: price + shipping + estimated tax

tools.name: get_product
tools.description: Full details for one sandbox product: description, GTIN, variants, stock, shipping, returns, and an estimate (price + shipping + estimated tax = estimated_total), also per variant.

tools.name: add_to_cart
tools.description: Add a product to a cart. Omit cart_id to create a new cart; reuse the returned cart_id on later calls. Carts expire 24 hours after the last change. Products with variants need variant_id.

tools.name: get_cart
tools.description: Show cart lines and totals (subtotal, shipping, tax estimate, total).

tools.name: get_payment_methods
tools.description: Payment options at the sandbox checkout: test cards, simulated USDC (Base, Ethereum, Solana, Polygon) and USDT (Ethereum, Tron, Solana), plus a sandbox x402 REST flow.

tools.name: checkout
tools.description: Place a SANDBOX order: nothing ships and no money moves. payment.method is 'card', 'usdc' or 'usdt'. card: only test cards work (4242424242424242 succeeds, 4000000000000002 declines; any future expiry, any 3-digit cvc). usdc (networks base, ethereum, solana, polygon) or usdt (ethereum, tron, solana): returns a simulated payment_request with the amount in token units (6 decimals), a SANDBOX pay_to that is not a real address, and an expiry; then call confirm_crypto_payment with a fake tx hash. Never send real funds or a real card.

tools.name: confirm_crypto_payment
tools.description: Confirm a USDC/USDT sandbox payment_request with a FAKE transaction hash (EVM: 0x + 64 hex; Tron: 64 hex; Solana: base58 signature). Hashes ending in 'dead' simulate a reverted tx, 'beef' an underpayment. Requests expire after 15 minutes.
